productConcept.name: Sable
productConcept.description: Sable is a bespoke woodworking studio in Glasgow making custom furniture and interior joinery from carefully selected British and European timber.
productConcept.rationale: The warm cream palette (#f2efe9), expansive EB Garamond letter-spacing (0.14em), generous hero padding (144px top), and languid motion timing (0.45s base, 0.75s slow) all point toward a craft-oriented product world where time and material are the primary values. The studio video briefs in concept_by_video.md — raw linen surfaces, overhead desk arrangements, slow workspace dolly — are precisely the imagery of a furniture workshop. Woodworking was chosen over print/publishing/paper worlds to find fresh product territory while remaining true to the aesthetic signals.

animationDecision: motion-tokens — motion system has non-trivial durations (0.45s base, 0.75s slow), named easing curve cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), and concept_by_video.md explicitly references scroll reveals with translate-Y and opacity. Always-animate threshold met.
